questions.question: How did God lead Israel through the wilderness?
options: By a pillar of cloud by day and fire by night
By the wooden staff that Moses carried out before them
By the stars and the rising of the sun
By scouts sent ahead to mark the way
questions.answer: By a pillar of cloud by day and fire by night

questions.question: Why did God not lead Israel by the shorter road through Philistine country?
options: Because that road was blocked by flooding
Lest they face war and turn back to Egypt
Because Pharaoh's army was guarding the route
So they could carry off the wealth of Egypt
questions.answer: Lest they face war and turn back to Egypt

questions.question: God commanded that every firstborn male be consecrated (set apart) to him.
Moses carried the bones of _____ out of Egypt, as Israel had sworn to do.
God went before the people by a pillar of _____ to lead them by day.
